title: Simulated Fur
description: A groomed stylized animal carries 420,032 GPU-simulated fur strands rendered as tapered view-facing ribbons, with hand-driven petting, stillness-based scratching, and fur-memory combing.
techniques: area-weighted surface sampling with analytic character shapes and groom frames
six-point Verlet strands with inextensible segments and persistent comb memory
view-facing tapered ribbons with fiber tangent scattering and hand occlusion
rigged hand capsules coupling contact, friction, petting, and scratch response
